props.caption: Wisk autonomy, Insitu aircraft and SkyGrid airspace software move into Archer’s perimeter while Boeing keeps equity and technology access.

items.note: The outbreak’s formal May clock now sits behind genomic and retrospective evidence reaching into February and March.
The geological service moved the same Chocó earthquake from 6.7 to 6.6 and then 7.4 within twenty-four minutes.
Thousands marched on Jharkhand’s legislature over examination integrity before police dispersed them.
Britain authorized Europe’s first oral GLP-1 obesity treatment while leaving NHS access to a separate gate.
Unitree’s retail IPO tranche drew applications equal to more than 8,000 times the shares offered.
Wind and convective fire behavior pushed the Huelva blaze beyond firefighters’ immediate suppression capacity.

items.kicker: Jharkhand’s Exam Queue Reaches the Assembly
items.what: Thousands marched in Ranchi over alleged civil-service examination wrongdoing and paper leaks. Police used tear gas, water cannon and batons; protesters want examinations canceled or repeated, systemic changes and a federal investigation.

items.kicker: Niebla Burns Outside the Usual Envelope
items.what: Andalusian authorities said wind, rough terrain and convective fire behavior had pushed the Huelva blaze beyond immediate suppression. Nearly 20,000 hectares had burned and roughly 500 people had evacuated by cutoff.

items.kicker: Britain Clears the Pill Before the Bill
items.what: Britain authorized Lilly’s once-daily orforglipron for weight management and some type 2 diabetes patients, the first European approval. The authorization does not place it on the NHS; NICE still decides cost-effectiveness and access.

Unitree’s Shanghai IPO retail tranche was about 8,288.82 times oversubscribed, triggering the clawback mechanism and leaving an online lot-winning rate near 0.018%. Allocation mechanics amplify the ratio; they do not certify a market-clearing valuation.

items.kicker: Intel Sells Equity Into the Rally
items.what: Intel proposed a $15 billion common-stock offering plus a possible $2.25 billion underwriters’ option. The company may direct proceeds to capital expenditure and working capital as its foundry turnaround keeps consuming industrial-scale cash.

A Lebanese judge indicted former central-bank governor Riad Salameh and former Bank Audi chief Samir Hanna on allegations including embezzlement and illicit enrichment. The filing is the first Salameh-linked indictment to include a commercial banker; the indictment text was not public by cutoff.

Egypt’s annual core inflation rose to 14.7% in July from 14.3% in June. One month does not end disinflation, but the increase complicates the timing of monetary easing until the composition becomes clear.

South Korea announced a 5 trillion won semiconductor fund for materials, components, equipment and fabless firms, plus 5 trillion won in trade finance. Power, water, land and supplier depth have moved inside the compute-territory plan.

Russian authorities reported at least 13 deaths and 39 injuries after Ukrainian drones reached Nizhnekamsk. Ukraine said it struck the TANECO refinery; the relationship between the intended target, impact sites and civilian deaths remained unresolved at cutoff.
